items.title: USC Trojan Food Pantry — Free Food
items.description: Free food at USC Trojan Food Pantry (USC Student Basic Needs). Schedule: Tue–Thu 10 AM–2 PM (Fall 2025 term hours). Eligibility: Currently enrolled USC students experiencing food insecurity; no dining-hall meal plan; free, intake form once per semester. Confirm hours before you go — supplies can run out. Source: community research, Oct 2026.
items.address: 1025 W 34th St (King Hall, Suite 103), Los Angeles, CA 90089
items.schedulePattern: Tue–Thu 10 AM–2 PM (Fall 2025 term hours)
